# 2nd Circle of Hell
**Year of Creation:** 2026  
**Author(s):** Connor Gallagher (ConSilverstone), Eden Osborne  
**Challenge Name:** the-2nd-circle-of-hell  
**Category:** Cryptography  
**Difficulty:** Trival-Easy  
  
## Description:  
A paranoid criminal creates a cypher to transfer illegal images via email.  
Investigators have tried to decrypt it using CyberChef but regardless what method they use something seems wrong with the formatting.  
NOTE: The flag is in all lowercase!

<details>
<summary>Solution & Flag</summary>
A crypography challenge that is a base64 encoded message. It has been encoded 5 times. The string must be de-encoded 5 times to reveal the flag. If it is still not visable you may need to zoon out to view the full ASCII art.
Flag: freshers{illegal_image}
